name: Intra-Company Transfer Visa
description: The D-7 visa is for employees of foreign companies being transferred to their Korean branch, subsidiary, or affiliate. It enables multinational corporations to relocate essential personnel to Korea.
tagline: Transfer to Korea with your company
keyRequirement: 1+ year employment at foreign company with Korean branch
targetAudience: Technical specialists relocating to Korean operations

restrictions: Must work at sponsoring company only
workPermission.notes: Cannot change employers without changing visa status

pathsTo.name: Professional Employment Visa
pathsTo.requirements: Secure a job offer from a different Korean company (not through intra-company transfer). New employer must sponsor your visa.
pathsTo.notes: For those who want to leave their multinational company and join a Korean employer directly. The new company must be willing to sponsor your E-7 visa.

pathsTo.name: Residence Visa (F-2-7 Points-Based)
pathsTo.requirements: Score 80+ on the F-2-7 points system. Long D-7 tenure counts toward Korea residence experience points.
pathsTo.notes: D-7 holders with long tenure can build enough points for F-2-7. F-2 removes employer restrictions and allows free job changes. Invest in TOPIK and KIIP courses to boost your points.

pathsTo.name: Job Seeking Visa
pathsTo.requirements: End of intra-company assignment or desire to seek new employment. Must have bachelor's degree.
pathsTo.notes: A fallback option if your intra-company assignment ends but you want to remain in Korea. D-10 gives you time to find new employment.
